videos.title: Introduction
videos.description: What to expect in the following videos and how things are organized and recordings created. Red-Color & Blue Color Gajalakshmi is introduced here. If you are creating the Plum color, start from Painting Clear Coat and continue.

videos.title: Introduction to Materials
videos.description: All the materials in your kit are explained, and you will learn to prep the canvas for painting. Applying a clear coat of gesso is a very important step; do not skip. The canvas should be FLAT before you start, so make sure you have weighted it on a flat surface for TWO (2) days.

videos.title: Painting Step 2: Second Coat
videos.description: Painting the second coat to get a beautiful velvet smooth finish.

videos.title: Creamy GOLD
videos.description: This GOLD was packed after Thanksgiving DEC2026. IF your gold looks creamy, please watch this video or else skip to the next one. The gold packaging has changed; how it is painted is still the same.

videos.title: Adding Gold -Part 1
videos.description: Learn to apply the gold paint to the Gajalakshmi painting. Key parts are demonstrated. Continue as indicated.

videos.title: Adding Gold -Part 3
videos.description: The GOLD Pot at the bottom with the gold coins is demonstrated here.

videos.title: W (White) and M (Magic) Pots
videos.description: This was packed with newer kits post NOV 2026. Please watch the video for its usage. We will honor older customers and send this out to you at no additional cost, so please reach out if you wish to receive this item.
